evals.prompt: I have a Next.js 15 app (App Router, Tailwind). Add a hero section for my indie zine "Paper Moon" with a hand-drawn vibe: a big title, one line of copy, and three or four wiggly doodle icons that draw themselves in when the page loads. Use @oreo-design/doodle-icons. Put the files in app/page.tsx and whatever else you need.
evals.expected_output: Working Next.js code: BoilFilter mounted once in app/layout.tsx (not in page or per icon); DoodleIcon with boilId and draw, staggered via drawDelay; only real icon names from the set; Schoolbell wired via next/font/google onto the title with a CSS variable; paper #F7F6F2 background and ink #2b2a33; sizes 32/48; nothing from Lucide or another icon set; nothing about the nav wiggling.
assertions: BoilFilter is mounted exactly once, in app/layout.tsx, not in page.tsx and not once per icon
Every DoodleIcon name used exists in the package's 191-icon set
Hero icons use both boilId and draw, and are staggered with drawDelay
Schoolbell is loaded via next/font/google and applied to the hero title
No import from lucide-react, @heroicons, react-icons, or any other icon library
Hero icons are sized to the headline (roughly 80-120px, via size prop or CSS width), not left at the 24 default
Page uses the real Oreo tokens: warm paper #f7f6f1 surfaces and ink #2b2a33, no framework accent hue

evals.prompt: Build me a settings page in React with three sections: General, Notifications, Privacy. Each row has a small icon on the left, a label, and a toggle on the right. Use the oreo doodle icons so it matches the rest of my app (we already have @oreo-design/doodle-icons installed and a <BoilFilter id="boil" /> in the layout).
evals.expected_output: Rows use still icons: no boilId and no draw on list/row icons, because UI chrome should hold still and draw would replay on re-render. size 24. Real names such as gear, bell, lock, shield, eye, user. Colour via CSS color/className, not stroke props. Does not re-mount BoilFilter. Optionally one boiling icon in the page header at most.
assertions: Every icon carries boilId (rows included); draw is kept off list rows so it does not replay on re-render
BoilFilter is not mounted again anywhere in the output
Every icon name used exists in the package's 191-icon set
Row icons are size 24 or use the default size
Any icon colour is set via className or CSS color, not a stroke attribute or edited paths
No import from another icon library

evals.prompt: my portfolio is plain html + css, no react no build step. i want a footer with a mail icon, a github icon and an X (twitter) icon in that sketchy wobbly style from doodle.oreoui.com. how do i do it? give me the actual html
evals.expected_output: Uses the standalone SVG files from the package (icons-animated/*.svg or icons/*.svg) via or inline markup, no React. States plainly that there are no GitHub or X logos in the set and does not fabricate them or pull logos from another icon set; offers link / external-link / at-sign / mail / send with text labels instead. Mentions the currentColor limitation and the inline-fetch alternative if recolouring is wanted. Optionally the Schoolbell for footer display text.
assertions: Output is plain HTML and CSS with no React, JSX, or build tooling
Uses the package's standalone SVG files (icons/ or icons-animated/) or their inline markup
States explicitly that GitHub and X logos are not in the set, and does not fabricate them or pull logos from another icon set
Substitutes real names from the set (e.g. mail with link, external-link, at-sign or send) paired with text labels
Mentions that an -loaded SVG cannot inherit currentColor, or inlines the SVG so it can be recoloured
No SVG path data is invented for any icon
